info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description: Retrieves a list of all configured alert definitions for the organization

post.description: Adds an alert definition. To learn more, see Configuring an Alert Rule.

get.description: Retrieves the alert definition information based on the specified ID

put.description: Updates an existing alert definition based on the specified ID

delete.description: Deletes an alert definition based on the specified ID

get.description: Retrieves a list of all configured Security alert rules for the organization. To learn more, see About Security & UEBA Alerts.

post.description: Adds a new Security alert rule. To learn more, go to For Security Alerts from Configuring an Alert Rule.

get.description: Retrieves the Security alert rule information based on the specified ID

put.description: Updates an existing Security alert rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Security alert rule

delete.description: Deletes a Security alert rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Security alert rule

get.description: Retrieves the statuses of all alert rules for an organization
Retrieves a list of all configured User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) alert rules. To learn more, go to UEBA Alerts from About Security & UEBA Alerts.

post.description: Adds a new UEBA alert rule. To learn more, go to For UEBA Alerts from Configuring an Alert Rule

get.description: Retrieves information about UEBA alert rule based on the specified ID

put.description: Updates an existing UEBA alert rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the UEBA alert rule

delete.description: Deletes a UEBA alert rule based on the specified ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the UEBA alert rule

get.description: Retrieves a list of all configured webhooks for an organization. To learn more, see About Webhooks.

post.description: Adds a new webhook for alert notifications. To learn more, see Adding a Webhook.

put.description: Updates an existing webhook based on the specified ID

delete.description: Deletes a webhook based on the specified ID

post.description: Tests a webhook configuration by sending a sample notification. Any non-2xx HTTP response from this webhook endpoint is treated as a failure, and redirects are not followed.

status.description: The status of the alert rule

occurrence.description: Specifies the occurrence of an ongoing alert for a specific threat or event type

trafficChangePercent.description: Specifies the percentage change in traffic

interval.description: The time span within which an event's occurrence triggers an alert

scope.description: Specifies if the alert is triggered for a user, location, department, or organization.

severity.description: The threat severity based on which the alert is triggered

comments.description: Additional information about the triggered alert

alertClass.description: The alert class for the rule

withinTime.description: The span of time within which an event's occurrence triggers an alert

minTimes.description: The minimum number of events to trigger the alert

windowSize.description: The window size for the alert

enableUpdate.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the alert rule and alert notification delivery is enabled

updateWindowSize.description: The window size for updates to the alert

locations.description: The internet gateway location from which the alert originated. If the transaction did not originate from a location that was defined in the alert rule, then it is recorded as coming from a remote user.

users.description: Users impacted by a particular threat or users who are a part of a preconfigured alert

departments.description: The department which was impacted by a particular threat or which was a part of a preconfigured alert

numSystemImpacted.description: Specifies the number of impacted systems

deleted.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether a configured alert is deleted

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of when the alert rule was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: User that last modified the alert rule

emailIds.description: The email aliases to receive alert notifications

channel.description: Specifies the type of channel for the UEBA alert rule. The UEBA_INLINE and UEBA_API channels cover multiple events and alert types based on organizational requirements.

action.description: The configured action for the UEBA alert rule

actionThreshold.description: The action threshold for the alert

countries.description: Countries for which the alert rule applies

casbApplications.description: The SaaS Security applications for which the alert rule applies

objectTypes.description: List of object types for which the UEBA alert rule is applied

docTypes.description: The document type to apply the alert rule

userGroupId.description: The user group ID for the alert

actionTimeInterval.description: The duration of action configured for the alert rule

dlpEngines.description: DLP engines whose violation is checked by the alert rule

alertClass.description: Specifies the alert class for the rule

eventTypes.description: The event type for the rule

updateWindowSize.description: The window size for updates to the alert

actionThreshold.description: The action threshold for the alert

entryNameL10n.description: Localization information for the entry name

obfuscated.description: Indicates whether the data is obfuscated

permissionError.description: The error code when a permission error occurs

ninetyFivePercentile.description: The 95th percentile value of the total across all entries in the report

partition.description: Indicates whether the data is partitioned

userName.description: The webhook username that is required for authentication. This field is applicable only when the authentication type is <bold>Basic</bold>. The webhook provider determines the authentication type used.

password.description: The webhook password that is required for authentication. This field is applicable only when the authentication type is <bold>Basic</bold>. The webhook provider determines the authentication type used.

authToken.description: The webhook bearer token provided by the webhook provider. This field is applicable when the authentication type is <bold>Token</bold>.

status.description: A Boolean value that specifies the webhook status

lastTriggered.description: The last triggered alert in a webhook configuration

authenticationType.description: The webhook authentication type. The webhook provider determines the authentication type used.

deleted.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether a webhook is deleted

lastModifiedTime.description: Timestamp of when the webhook was last modified

lastModifiedBy.description: User that last modified the webhook

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of an ID and name
